system.description:
You deal [Pursuit:5] in addition to the [Weapon Attack] with this weapon when you land a critical hit. A magical curved sword that shines with the light of three moons. Those who look directly at its blade while it is in an unstable state are affected by the madness of the moon, causing their movements to slow.

Rusted Moon Steel [Core Material] (60G) + Scimitar (100G) + Clear Ring (110G) + [Magic Catalyst 5] (40G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (180G)
